svg.title: Evidence anchors guide resumption while uncertainty stays explicit
svg.desc: Source C0 plus uncommitted D1 and fixture F1 anchor a constructed resumption brief. R1 preserves the expected versus observed mismatch and abandoned explanations. The next session checks current state and reproduction before a bounded adapter investigation.
